mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects restrictive monetary policy that increases the cost of capital for corporations, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.5% within the last month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate an aggressive monetary tightening cycle to combat inflation, which increases uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL MoM change > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS MoM change > 0.1%
failure_condition: The interaction signal (both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rising) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1500 and UNRATE < 3.8%), strong demand for housing and a tight labor market signal robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and UNRATE < 3.8%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (relative to 2017 base) indicates sustained economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 305 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or increase interest rates, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST MoM change > 0.5% and RSAFS MoM change > 0.3%
failure_condition: The interaction signal (both HOUST and RSAFS rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017 base) signals an economic contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
